Brand essentials

Name and relationship

Approved name: Local Media Gallery

Relationship: A ShruggieTech project

Written form: Write Local Media Gallery as the name; use localmedia.gallery only as an address.

Approved words

Slogan
Your media presented beautifully.
Short description
A lightweight, interactive gallery for browsing local images and videos.

Visual signatures

Mark: Use the larger icon beside Local Media above Gallery. Preserve the supplied hierarchy and proportions. Keep the domain for address use.

Color: The formal identity uses Jade on dark surfaces and Deep Jade on light surfaces.

Type: Display Space Grotesk; body Geist; mono Geist Mono. See colors and type details.

Where each asset belongs

Use the delivered logo and mark files for their declared surfaces and sizes. The asset catalog lists each verified variant and download. The color and type sections give exact values.

The reduced mark takes over at and below 32 px.

Usage limits

Keep the delivered artwork geometry unchanged.

Implementation authority

Exact kit facts

This brand uses its own delivered interface binding; do not assume a ShruggieTech house palette. The current hosted documentation facts (JSON) declare schema version 1 and documentation contract version 1.2.0. In a downloaded kit, enforcement/documentation-facts.json governs those pinned bytes.

Interface overrides

No brand-specific interface overrides are declared. Use the delivered binding and its default rules.

Color

Formal identity colors and interface cues

Identity accent hue 176.1 in OKLCH. Palette selection is independent of ownership and sibling hues.

Formal identity colors

These approved source values belong to marks and brand applications. A color used in artwork is not automatically a warning or action cue.

ColorHEXSourceUse
Gallery Jade#69D4BBbrand.accent.brightIdentity artwork on dark surfaces
Deep Jade#08745Fbrand.accent.accessibleIdentity artwork and readable accent on light surfaces

Approved combinations

ApplicationFormal colorsArtworkUse
Contact sheetprimarylogo.fullFour equal gallery tiles with image and video cutouts

Correct: use Deep Jade (#08745F) in its approved identity application; pair the Action cue (#08745F) with a descriptive button or link label. Misuse: a lone identity swatch as the only action signal.

Interface cues on dark surfaces

Use words, icons, outlines, or state attributes with color. A shared HEX value does not merge identity and interface roles.

Interface cues on light surfaces

HEX uses uppercase pairs; sRGB uses integer 0-255 channels; HSL uses degrees and percentages rounded to one decimal; OKLCH uses four decimals for lightness and chroma plus one for hue; CIELAB uses D50 with lightness as a percentage and two decimals per channel.

Light surfaces

The bright accent #69D4BB measures 1.64:1 on the light reading surface and is never text there. The light block substitutes #08745F at 5.24:1. The legal foreground on an accent fill is #000000 at 11.74:1.

Body in Geist at 400. Approved weights are display 500, 700, body 400, 500, and mono 400. Undeclared weights are prohibited.

Delivery

Complete asset catalog

A brand mark is the symbol alone; a logo lockup combines approved elements. Wide and stacked layouts are separate designs. Full and reduced identify source detail. Full color or monochrome identifies ink treatment. A clear background is transparent; for light or dark names the intended viewing surface. Social share images are separate opaque compositions. Preferred descriptive filenames and existing paths contain the same approved artwork. Full asset glossary.

Canvas 1000 × 1000 units, clear space 100 units (12.9 percent of artwork width). Below 32 px the reduced master takes over.

Fixed lockup proportions

lockupmark heightgapalignment
horizontal160 units36 unitsoptical center
stacked4.00C0.65Ccentered on wordmark ink width

The horizontal row records its approved master composition. C is the outlined wordmark cap height used by the stacked lockup. X is the 70-unit G channel. Keep one X clear around every master. Never resize the mark and wordmark independently.

Compatibility aliases are listed with their canonical delivery group; byte-identical aliases do not create duplicate previews.
